# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Related Issue / RFC

Link the relevant Issue or RFC when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have stated whether this changes an Apver core concept.
- [ ] I have determined whether an RFC is required and linked it if so.
- [ ] I have preserved backward compatibility or explained the compatibility impact.
- [ ] I have updated all affected documentation.
- [ ] I have included tests where applicable after an implementation exists.
- [ ] I have stated whether this modifies a provenance-sensitive record.
- [ ] I have not rewritten, obscured, or removed Apver's original historical provenance.
- [ ] I have not included secrets, tokens, or personal data.
